slots.text: Follow the opening sequence and arrive at Leblanc. This is a story-controlled day.
Continue the opening events and investigate the mysterious app.
Attend school and continue the Kamoshida storyline.
Follow the story into the Metaverse and begin the first Palace sequence.
Continue the Kamoshida Palace introduction and learn the basic infiltration mechanics.
Buy Vitality Aojiru at the Shibuya drink stand. If available, prepare Bio Nutrients for the plant and work at Triple Seven.
Visit the Yongen-Jaya bathhouse for a Charm boost.
Kamoshida aftermath and story events.
Complete the crossword, then work on Infiltration Tools to build Proficiency.
Story events.
Study at Leblanc to improve Knowledge.
Story events.
Study at Leblanc again.
The Phantom Thieves are formally established.
Use Bio Nutrients on the plant. Clean Leblanc when available and continue the Fool Confidant progression.
Class lecture; take the chalk-dodge opportunity if desired.
Spend time with Ann. Lovers Rank 2 becomes available with the required Kindness.
Apply for and work at the beef bowl shop if the required Proficiency is met.
Answer the classroom question.
A Mementos request becomes available; complete it if following the schedule.
Use the work desk to craft infiltration tools and raise Proficiency.
Mishima's Moon Confidant progresses automatically.
Use the shopping program if useful, then improve Guts with the Shibuya drink stand or follow the planned activity.
Spend time with Ryuji and progress Chariot Rank 7 → 8. Keep a Chariot Persona available for the most efficient affinity gains.
Study at the diner and order the Surprise Sando for additional Knowledge and Guts.
Spend time with Takemi and progress Death Rank 5 → 6. Keep a Death Persona available.
Check the TV quiz, then spend time with Sojiro for Hierophant Rank 3 → 4 if following this route.
Read Buchiko's Story on the train.
Continue the book during class when permitted to finish it and gain Kindness.
Progress Ann's Lovers Confidant.
Complete the crossword and progress Kawakami's Temperance Confidant when available.
Answer the classroom question.
Follow the planned Confidant or Social Stat activity for the route.
Use the available Sunday activity to continue the schedule's Social Stat or Confidant progression.
Use the evening slot for the route's planned activity and prepare for the following week.
